D5/S0/Certificates/MinkowskiNullConeRigi.name: D5.S0.Certificates.MinkowskiNullConeRigidity.eq_smul_minkowski_of_null
D5/S0/Certificates/MinkowskiNullConeRigi.signature: theorem eq_smul_minkowski_of_null {d : Nat} (S : QuadraticForm Real (Space d)) (hnull : forall v, minkowski d v = 0 -> S v = 0) : S = S (1, 0) • minkowski d

D5/S0/Certificates/MinkowskiNullConeRigi.name: D5.S0.Certificates.MinkowskiNullConeRigidity.exists_smul_minkowski_of_null
D5/S0/Certificates/MinkowskiNullConeRigi.signature: theorem exists_smul_minkowski_of_null {d : Nat} (S : QuadraticForm Real (Space d)) (hnull : forall v, minkowski d v = 0 -> S v = 0) : exists f : Real, S = f • minkowski d

D5/S0/Certificates/MinkowskiNullConeRigi.name: D5.S0.Certificates.MinkowskiNullConeRigidity.null_cone_spatial_rigidity
D5/S0/Certificates/MinkowskiNullConeRigi.signature: theorem null_cone_spatial_rigidity {d : Nat} (S : QuadraticForm Real (Space d)) (hnull : forall v, minkowski d v = 0 -> S v = 0) (w : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin d)) : S (0, w) = -S (1, 0) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 ∧ QuadraticMap.polar S (1, 0) (0, w) = 0
